paper.title_en: Gravitational collapse to extremal black holes with $Λ>0$: counterexamples to the third law without charge
paper.abstract_en: We study the dynamical formation of the extremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter solution, in both its time orientations, and the related Nariai solution. We prove that there exist spherically symmetric, regular Cauchy data for the Einstein-scalar field system with $\mathbb S^3$ topology, for any scalar field mass $\mathfrak{m}\geq 0$, that lead to the formation of an exactly extremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter black hole in finite time, and that moreover the apparent horizon of the solution is exactly isometric to that of the subextremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter solution at earlier times. We also show that if the scalar field mass satisfies $\mathfrak{m}>\sqrtΛ/2$, an analogous result holds having the extremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter white hole or the Nariai solution in place of the black hole. In the black hole case, the exactly extremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter region is bounded to the future by two event horizons and can be seen as the analogue of the exterior region in the asymptotically flat case. We moreover establish that these two black hole horizons that bound the exactly extremal Schwarzschild-de Sitter region are the only event horizons present in the spacetime, something non-trivial given the existence of multi-black hole configurations when $Λ> 0$. Consequently, the solutions arising from these data can be thought to constitute, in particular, regular counterexamples to the third law of black hole thermodynamics with $Λ>0$ arising from the collapse of physically plausible matter which is moreover uncharged. Our approach to construct the Cauchy data relies on $C^k$ characteristic gluing results for the Einstein-scalar field system in spherical symmetry, in the spirit of [KU25].

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文构造了Λ>0时爱因斯坦-标量场系统的球对称正则Cauchy数据，证明可在有限时间内形成恰好极端的Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞（或白洞/Nariai解），并给出无电荷情形下第三定律的正则反例；理论构造与因果结构论证有实质深度，选题具体且具备明确的新颖性，值得点开细读。
decision.title_zh: Λ>0时向极端黑洞的引力坍缩：无电荷情形下第三定律的反例
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究极端Schwarzschild-de Sitter解在其两个时间取向上的动力学形成，以及相关的Nariai解。我们证明：对于任意标量场质量 $\mathfrak{m}\geq 0$，存在具有 $\mathbb S^3$ 拓扑的爱因斯坦-标量场系统的球对称正则Cauchy数据，这些数据会在有限时间内导致一个恰好极端的Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞的形成，而且该解的视界（apparent horizon）在较早时刻与次极端Schwarzschild-de Sitter解的视界恰好等距。我们还证明，如果标量场质量满足 $\mathfrak{m}>\sqrtΛ/2$，则类似的结论成立，只是以极端Schwarzschild-de Sitter白洞或Nariai解代替黑洞。在黑洞情形下，恰好极端的Schwarzschild-de Sitter区域在未来方向被两个事件视界所界定，并可看作渐近平坦情形中外区（exterior region）的类比。此外，我们确立了界定该恰好极端Schwarzschild-de Sitter区域的这两个黑洞视界是时空中仅有的两个事件视界，考虑到当 $Λ> 0$ 时存在多黑洞构型，这一结论并非平凡。因此，由这些数据产生的解尤其可被视为 $Λ>0$ 时黑洞热力学第三定律的正则反例，这些反例源自物理上合理的物质的坍缩，而且该物质不带电荷。我们构造这些Cauchy数据的方法依赖于球对称下爱因斯坦-标量场系统的 $C^k$ 特征粘合（characteristic gluing）结果，其思路与[KU25]一致。
keywords_en: third law of black hole thermodynamics
